facts.tagline: The valley's weekly paper, online every day

sections.name: Transport
sections.about: Roads, bridges, matatu routes and the northern rail extension. Report a road problem to the newsroom by email; the Times passes reports to the county roads office and follows up in print.

sections.name: Council
sections.about: What the county council voted on, spent and decided. Council sittings are open to the public at the county hall in Mto Mkuu, and the Times publishes how every ward's councillor voted.

sections.name: Farming and weather
sections.about: Rain, harvests, crop prices and advice from extension officers. Rain figures come from the county's own gauges.

sections.name: Business
sections.about: Markets, shops, jobs and money in the valley. Traders can send their prices to the newsroom each week; the Times prints the figures it can check.

sections.name: Community
sections.about: Schools, clinics, sport and the people of the valley. Send news of your school, clinic, church or club to the newsroom by email; the Times prints what it can confirm.

rail.title: The northern rail extension
rail.about: The commuter line from Mto Mkuu to Kivuli, from the first study to the tenders.

budget.title: The county budget
budget.about: How the council raises and spends the county's money, year by year.

market.title: Ndovu market's move
market.about: The traders of Ndovu market and the plan to move them to a new site.

house_rules: Desks never write news. They answer from published reporting.
Every claim links to a dated, bylined story.
Subscriber stories: headline and link only, unless you subscribe.
Corrections reach answers and digests within minutes.
The editor approves each desk's scope and wording.

digest.name: Friday five
contract: Every Friday at 07:00: five {topics} stories, two lines each, with links
Only stories Tana Valley Times published that week. A desk writes the two lines; the editor sets the rules
Your email and these topics. Not your reading history
One tap in any email. Your topics are deleted with it

subscription.note: KSh 300 is a sample price until the editor sets the real one
includes: Every subscriber story in full, including the archive
subscription.renewal: This sample takes one payment for one month. It doesn't renew by itself; pay again to keep reading.

desks.name: Newsroom
desks.mandate: I answer from Tana Valley Times's published stories and link every one, with its byline and date. I never write news.
starters: Where does the rail extension stand?
Is the extension a good idea?

desks.name: Archive
desks.mandate: I find past issues by date and topic, back to the first story online.
starters: When did the rail story start?
What did the paper report last month?

desks.name: Subscriptions
desks.mandate: I handle subscriptions and the Friday five. I never take card details in a chat.
starters: How do I stop the Friday five?
